items.title: Simplified PROP presentations are complete for six near-Clifford quantum circuit fragments
items.author: Colin Blake
items.source_version: Fixed arXiv2602.09874v3 full version with extended proofs and original circuit PDFs; current-version landing retrieved2026-10-14 explicitly CC BY4.0; same work as FSCD2026.6
items.difficulty_reason: The author transports completeness from older presentations into a common PROP syntax with structural swaps, resolves scalar-group mismatches for qutrit Clifford and Clifford+CS, defines explicit encoding/decoding maps and derives every finite source relation in the reduced targets. The native extensions retain all generator checks, circuit decoding chains and scalar-refinement proof. This non-routine construction supports H2; paper identity and proof length are not difficulty evidence.
